description_en: Update a table in an Alibaba Cloud Model Studio data connector using a file from an authorized OSS bucket
description_zh: 使用已授权OSS Bucket中的文件更新阿里云百炼数据连接中表格连接器中的表格
kebab_example: aliyun bailian update-table-from-authorized-oss --workspace-id llm-3z7uw7fwz0vxxxx --table-id table_100b51399c404966b7d49f71e388a3fd_12738336 --oss-bucket yinghuo-ai --oss-region-id cn-beijing --oss-key a0deedbce4a8162b8d66c63ace28330c --update-mode OVERWRITE --api-version 2023-12-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateTableFromAuthorizedOss

parameters.help_en: ID of the workspace that owns the file. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.help_zh: 文件所属的业务空间 ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2587495.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: ID of the table to update
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: Name of the OSS bucket. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/177682.html
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: Region ID of the OSS bucket. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html
parameters.help_zh: OSS Bucket的地域ID。获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html
parameters.name: oss_region_id

parameters.help_en: Object key of the file in the OSS bucket. For details, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273129.html
parameters.help_zh: 导入文件在OSS Bucket中的键名（Key），详见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/273129.html
parameters.name: oss_key

parameters.help_en: Update mode. Valid values: APPEND and OVERWRITE
parameters.help_zh: 更新模式，仅支持APPEND（追加）和OVERWRITE（覆盖）
parameters.name: update_mode
